title: 'No more oil or money': Trump urges Cuba to cut deal with US 'before it's too late'
summary: A week after the capture of Venezuela's President Nicolas Maduro by US forces, President Donald Trump on Sunday urged Cuba to “make a deal before it's too late” and the country finds itself without Venezuelan oil or money. The loss of Venezuelan oil would be highly detrimental to Cuba's economy, according to US intelligence reports.
